tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List all countries Siima sells a single-country eSIM plan for, with plan counts and the cheapest total price per country. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Counts and prices cover country plans only, so they stay comparable — many more countries are reachable via multi-country plans; call list_r

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List every multi-country coverage area Siima sells — regional areas such as "Europe+", "South East Asia" or "CENAM", and worldwide plans — with the countries every plan in it covers, how many plans it has, and its cheapest total price. Use this for a trip crossing several countries: pick a coverage

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan, create_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan, create_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
